text: Yes, all of the 2021 tree-cover loss occurred inside the pine plantation. The MGAP 2021 forest map shows that 68.1 ha of the 81.3 ha loss area was within planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), with only 13.2 ha outside mapped forest areas. The loss was corroborated by multiple sources, confirming it was entirely within the asset boundary.
